page.layout: One printed page: digitiser's cover sheet for e-rara.ch. Top right the e-rara logo; centred title block; below a rule, a block of multilingual access notes and licence statements; bottom right the Visual Library logo. None of this is printed text of the book, so it is left out.
page.notes: Cover sheet of the digitiser (e-rara.ch, Zentralbibliothek Zürich). Its title block reads "Dissertatio de artibus magicis prima", Heidegger, Johann Heinrich, Tiguri, 1682. The logos, the access notes in German, English, French and Italian, and the licence statements belong to the digitiser and are not transcribed as book text.
